as_told.title: Oppenheimer's rumored 'first atom bomb in modern history' remark and Vedic death weapons

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats what he calls an apocryphal story about Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the building of the first atomic bomb in 1945. As Michels tells it, a student asked how it felt to be the first person to create a nuclear weapon, and Oppenheimer answered that he was the first in modern history, a remark the story links to the Bhagavad Gita, an ancient Hindu scripture. If true, it would hint that nuclear weapons existed in the ancient past.
